page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the ARM-based Alibaba Yitian 710 processor. The instance provides 8 dedicated physical cores running at 2.75 GHz with a single thread per core, accompanied by 64 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 64 MB of shared L3 cache. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, matching a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance includes a 5 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operates on a KVM hypervisor, includes hardware AES acceleration, and does not provide bundled local storage or dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark results place the ecs.c8y.2xlarge in the middle tier across standard compute and memory benchmarks. The 8 dedicated Yitian cores achieved 14489.92 in stress-ng multi-core and 1820.08 in single-core workloads, matching average class performance. The memory subsystem demonstrated 96.36 GB/sec in large-block uncached reads and 41.19 GB/sec in writes. In application-level benchmarks, the instance sustained 13.18 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 12.71 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. A primary performance constraint appears in intensive cryptographic operations, where the PassMark encryption test placed in the bottom 25%, as well as medium-scale LLM inference (7B model) yielding poor generation speeds.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM-based custom silicon architecture delivers solid resource density and compute performance per resource unit without the overhead of simultaneous multithreading. It provides dedicated execution pipelines across all 8 cores. The lack of onboard local NVMe disks requires reliance on networked block storage for persistent data, which affects raw I/O throughput planning.

The ecs.c8y.2xlarge is suited for ARM-compatible workloads such as web application hosting, microservices, continuous integration pipelines, caching layers like Redis, and batch data processing jobs where high memory density is not required.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance powered by the 2.75 GHz ARM-based Alibaba Yitian 710 processor. Configured with 8 dedicated physical cores and 16.0 GB of memory, it provides a 1:2 core-to-memory profile suitable for compute-heavy ARM applications. The instance delivers 5 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, relies entirely on network-attached storage due to having no local storage, and includes no GPU hardware. Synthetic and real-world testing shows stable median performance across general computing tasks, sustaining 14489.92 in stress-ng multi-core tests, 13.18 million operations per second in Redis SET operations, and 12.71 GB/sec in static web throughput. Its architecture delivers efficient dedicated compute power without thread contention, though cryptographic throughput and larger language model inference show clear limitations. The server is well positioned for containerized microservices, build nodes, web serving, and distributed caching tiers.
